slides.title: Navigation Guards
Programmatic Navigation
slides.content:
# Navigating with Code

Instead of using `<router-link>`, you can navigate programmatically:

```javascript
// push – adds a new entry to history
router.push('/about')
router.push({ path: '/user/1' })
router.push({ name: 'user', params: { id: 1 } })

// replace – replaces the current entry
router.replace('/about')

// go – navigate history
router.go(-1) // back one step
router.go(1)  // forward
```

In Options API, use `this.$router`. In Composition API, use `const router = useRouter()`.
